original_test_intent: Qualify five hundred full-width Gen3-to-Gen6 transitions on the specified GB-NV-PVP PCIe path, contingent on explicit evidence that the complete platform and toolchain implement Gen6.
original_method: Prove end-to-end Gen6 support and pin Speed Change 36; for every cycle establish full-width Gen3, request Gen6, capture equalization/LTSSM and settled width plus error/health deltas, and stop before another cycle on any unsupported, missing, or failed result; recover out of band.
manual_activity: Platform/PCIe owner certifies Gen6 and approves Speed Change 36; lab personnel isolate the SUT and own console or physical recovery.
required_inputs: Positive Gen6/full-width capability evidence for every path element and firmware
Gen3 entry, Gen6 request, equalization/LTSSM, settle, width, transient, and error rules
safety_requirements: No execution or register forcing without positive Gen6 support
Dedicated SUT with stable power/cooling and out-of-band console
Stop on unsupported mode, wrong start, failed/late or reduced-width Gen6, new AER, endpoint/GPU/host loss, reset, thermal/power anomaly, or artifact gap
agent_execution_scope: Validate capability, topology, tool, and acceptance
Run only the approved Speed Change 36 operation
Fail closed before the next cycle
Do not infer support, force speed bits, accept downgrade, clear evidence, retry, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Certify Gen6 path and Speed Change 36 semantics
Review all 500 results and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Gen3-to-Gen6 interpretation matches the source, but generic LTSSM wording does not prove Gen6 feasibility or define the exact safe operation and evidence contract.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only after documented Gen6 capability, use the pinned Speed Change 36 recipe with atomic Gen3 entry, Gen6 equalization, full-width settle, and error/health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: LTSSM, 500 Gen3-to-Gen6 transitions, expected width/speed, no errors, no bundle, and 30/180-minute allocation remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Separate the Gen6 support gate from the fail-closed per-cycle transition ledger.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds feasibility proof, channel identity, state trajectory, durable evidence, aborts, and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Gen5 operation, an unsupported exposed value, or one final Gen6 snapshot cannot prove five hundred genuine full-width Gen6 transitions from Gen3.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unsupported or marginal Gen6 training can strand the endpoint/host, loop in recovery, downtrain, or create persistent AER.

project_override_considerations: If the exact revision lacks Gen6/full-width support, mark execution BLOCKED and preserve the testcase; do not downgrade to Gen5 or reuse another row's evidence.
expected_evidence: Positive Gen6 capability proof and pinned tool/configuration
Complete path/lane map and Gen3-to-Gen6 state/timing/error contract
Raw monotonic 1-500 records with initial/intermediate/equalization/final states
First-fault recovery or clean final state and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Adds a mandatory Gen6 feasibility gate and fail-closed transaction evidence without weakening the source generation or loop count.
independent_technical_reasoning: Gen6 is a property of the entire path, not a command-line value. Every root port, retimer, board segment, endpoint, and firmware layer must support it before stress is safe. Each counted cycle must then prove Gen3 entry and full-width Gen6 equalization with new-error deltas; otherwise a downtrain or already-set state can masquerade as coverage. Absent capability means execution BLOCKED, not permission to change the target.
